item.name: The MTA-STS Policy Reports - TLS endpoint responds with the data available within MTA-STS policy report files.

request.name: The MTA-STS Policy Reports - TLS endpoint responds with the data available within MTA-STS policy report files.

description.content: The MTA-STS Policy Reports - TLS endpoint responds with the data available within MTA-STS policy report files.

query.description: (Required) Start date of the report (ISO 8601 format) -  The date value should be formatted as YYYY-MM-DD. This is the starting date of the time range you wish to retrieve the report for
(Required) End date of the report (ISO 8601 format) - The date value should be formatted as YYYY-MM-DD. This is the end date of the time range you wish to retrieve the report for
Array of domain names to filter the report data. If not provided, the report will return data for all existing domains on the account.
Array of domain names to filter the report data. If not provided, the report will return data for all existing domains on the account.
policy-mx-host to filter the report data.
policy-mode to filter the report data.
Limit the number of records returned. Default is 20.
Page number for pagination. Default is 1.
Sort the results by a specific field. The '-' prefix indicates descending order.

response.name: Ok - Returns TLS reporting data with pagination information. The response includes: Count (total number of records), Next/Previous (URLs for pagination), and Results array containing TLS report entries. Each result entry contains: domain (domain name), report-id (unique identifier), version (policy version), policy-mode (enforcement mode), policy-mx-host (MX hostname), and max-age (policy cache duration in seconds).

query.description: (Required) Report Identifier - The report ID is a unique identifier for the TLS report. It is typically a string of alphanumeric characters that is generated by the reporting system. This ID is used to reference and retrieve specific reports files.

(Required) Domain Name - The domain name is the name of the domain for which the TLS report is generated. It is typically in the format of "example.com". This parameter is used to filter the results to a specific domain.
policy-mode to filter the report data.
policy-type to filter the report data.
